notes_for_editor: Location and elevation come from the survey row and a summit directory; the directory's elevation of 1,286 feet supports the survey's 1285 being in feet, which the record assumes (391.7 m). The survey point (32.92225, -84.57507) and the directory point (32.9181858, -84.5732577) are roughly 0.5 km apart by my calculation; the record keeps the survey point and the story uses it. Do not confuse with GA037 'Meriwether Lookout Tower' (33.03013, -84.75687, survey note 'BLL-63472 gfc-419'), a different tower in the same county, which is not used. Not in the cached NHLR Georgia index or the FFLOS Georgia list. Two web searches found only the summit directory and a Georgia hiking blog that does not mention this site. No source describes a tower on the summit, no photo was found, and status and access stay unknown.
